headlines.description: — The good news for the Miami Heat is that the Boston Celtics might not be back in South Florida for a few months.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derrick White scores 38, Celtics top Heat 102-88 to take a 3-1 East playoff series lead

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — For all the scoring Shai Gilgeous-Alexander does for Oklahoma City, his hustle back on defense after having a shot blocked was a pivotal part of a playoff series-clinching victory over the New Orleans Pelicans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williams, Gilgeous-Alexander, lead OKC to a 97-89 Game 4 victory -- and sweep of the Pelicans

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — Jamal Murray overcame a strained left calf, management's suggestion he sit this one out and another haymaker from the Los Angeles Lakers to score 32 points and sink the game-winner with 3.6 seconds left Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray scores 32 and hits game-winner in Nuggets' 108-106 series-clinching victory over Lakers
